body:
Rework for the review at `e04cf9f82`. The new head is `d1eb84020`.

1. Blocker: the `UnitTestsOnly` proof read only the `lib.rs` module tree.
   - Fix: `seen_by` now reads each `.rs` file in the crate directory (`src/`, `src/bin/`, `tests/`, `benches/`, `examples/`). It answers `Library` when a file names the changed file as a path part (`#[path]`, `include!`, also over two lines). It also answers `Library` when a file other than the proven parent declares `mod <seg>;` that can load the file or one of its ancestor modules. An indented `mod <seg>;` also answers `Library`.
   - Pin: `heavy_files_tests::a_second_compile_root_that_names_the_file_keeps_the_crate_reach`. It has four probes: `mod t;` in `main.rs`, `#[path = "../src/t.rs"]` in `tests/`, `#[path = "../t.rs"]` in `src/bin/`, and `mod a;` in `main.rs` for the nested `a/u.rs`. A control case (`mod t;` in `tests/x.rs` loads `tests/t.rs`) stays narrow.
   - Effect: `crates/motion/src/drilling/tests.rs` is now wide, because `tests/stock_seam.rs` has the string `"tests.rs"`. This is the safe direction. The pin `a_cfg_test_module_reaches_only_the_unit_tests_of_its_crate` now uses `drilling/tests_cross.rs`.
2. Line endings: `heavy.rs` and `heavy_files_tests.rs` are LF again. `git diff --stat origin/main -- xtask/src/heavy.rs` shows 33 insertions and 4 deletions.

The decision file shows the new rule. Gate with `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`:
- `cargo test -j 6 -p xtask --bin xtask`: 329 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

`origin/main` had no new commits, so the merge was empty.

Ready to merge. It is on the v0.26.0 cut list (cut line 2026-11-23T19:22Z). Class: SAME. The merge relies on the review at `d1eb84020`. Main moved after that review only by #3626 and #3549, which touch other files. `git merge-tree` with the current main is clean.
